notes: Successful HEAD200/206 headers plus ERR_ABORTED are retained as transport observations, not silently counted as failed content reads.
Same path does not prove a duplicate: query/arguments and consumer identity must be compared in raw evidence.
encodedBytes is a diagnostic only, not evidence of faster load time.
Intentional blocked mutations are not successful writes.
Header wait timing combines network/proxy/server and does not isolate database execution time.
